notes_for_editor: Only one source (firelookout.com) describes the tower, and its dates are decades only. Forest Lookouts and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list agree the tower is gone but add no detail. Staffing and access are not in any source. The IRA commentary is an advocacy submission about the roadless area and is cited only for hunter use of the area; it says nothing about the lookout. A PeakVisor search snippet gave 7,149 ft against firelookout.com's 7153'; it was not fetched, so it is not cited. Brief record checked: county, agency and kind (tower) match the sources.
